question: By how many percentage points did acid washing lower the ash content (Aad) of the lignite used for co-pyrolysis with sawdust, and by what share of its original value?
expect: 7.02 to 1.48: 5.54 points, about 79% of the original (78.9%) (Table 1)
rendered:
The original lignite coal had an ash content of 7.02%, and after acid washing, it had an ash content of 1.48%. 

The difference in ash content is 7.02 - 1.48 = 5.54%.

The ash content was lowered by 5.54 / 7.02 = 0.788 or 78.8% of its original value.
